name: button-hover-right

frames.best_why: The pill is fully widened with Visit and the arrow both clear, and the cursor sits below rather than on the text.

tagline: A round arrow button stretches into a pill reading Visit on hover.
summary: A circular blue button that shows only a white arrow. Hovering widens it into a pill that reveals the word Visit beside the arrow, and leaving shrinks it back.
appearance: A small round button in a navy-to-indigo gradient with a pale blue outline and a white right arrow centred. Expanded, it becomes a wide pill holding white Visit text with the arrow at its right end.
behaviour: On hover the circle stretches sideways into a pill while Visit fades and slides into view; the arrow stays pinned to the right. Leaving shrinks it back to a circle and fades the label out.
search_phrases: circle button expands to show text
arrow button that grows on hover
use_when: Space is tight and a single clear action can start as an icon and reveal its label on hover.
avoid_when: Hover is the only way to see the label, so touch and keyboard users only ever get the arrow.
customise: The label, gradient, border and arrow are hardcoded; it takes no props, so text and colours need a file edit.
weight_why: One button with a CSS width and opacity transition, no JavaScript.

a11y.note: The button is focusable and the word Visit stays in the DOM, but the label only becomes visible on hover, never on focus.

issues: The Visit label is invisible unless a pointer hovers, so touch users never see it.
polish_why: Clean gradient and a smooth one-gesture reveal, but it is a very common pattern with little else.
title: Expanding Icon Button
